meta.name: cheat-trends
meta.description: 从配置的热点源（HN / Reddit / YouTube trending / B 站热门 / 等）抓今天的热门话题，去重 + 粗打分 + 写入 candidates.md。**绝大部分人没有候选池——这是让"我没素材"问题在 onboarding 第二步就消失的钥匙**。触发词："抓热点"/"fetch trends"/"今天有什么可做的"/"trending now"/"找选题"。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从热门源抓取今日话题，生成候选选题池
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天为写什么内容发愁，需要灵感来源
copy.tagline_en: Fetch today's trending topics from hot sources and build a candidate pool
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to find content ideas daily and need inspiration

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会从你配置的热点源（如 Hacker News、Reddit、B 站等）抓取今天的热门话题，自动去重并打分，然后写入候选列表，供你后续挑选创作素材。
howto.when: 当你说出“抓热点”、“fetch trends”、“今天有什么可做的”、“trending now”或“找选题”等触发词时，Claude 会执行热点抓取流程。

say.note: Claude 会执行热点抓取，并询问你要加入哪些候选。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will fetch today's trending topics from your configured sources (e.g., Hacker News, Reddit, Bilibili), deduplicate and score them, then write to a candidate list for you to pick as content ideas.
howto.when_en: When you say trigger phrases like "抓热点", "fetch trends", "今天有什么可做的", "trending now", or "找选题", Claude will execute the trend-fetching workflow.

say_en.note: Claude fetches trends from default source (manual-paste) and lists candidates.
Fetches up to 10 items each from Hacker News and Bilibili popular.
Claude fetches trends and asks which to add to candidates.
